idh.reasoning: The metadata shows an older adult with a large, markedly enhancing frontal mass, substantial edema, necrosis, ventricular/ependymal involvement, deep white-matter invasion, and midline-crossing enhancement/edema with mass effect. This pattern is more typical of IDH-wildtype diffuse glioma than IDH-mutant glioma, which more often presents at younger age and with less aggressive enhancement/necrosis. Features that partially argue against wildtype include frontal cortical involvement and solitary presentation, which can be seen in IDH-mutant diffuse gliomas. Overall, the aggressive enhancing and necrotic phenotype in a 66-year-old supports IDH-wildtype.
